definition_zh: 提审；传讯；（比喻）谴责、控诉
definition_en: to formally charge someone with a crime in court and require them to answer
core_image: 被告被押上法庭当庭听取指控
scene: 法庭里法槌一响，全体起立，被告被押到被告席。The suspect will be arraigned before the judge on Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 arraign 是「提审」（第 1 个义项：正式到庭听取指控）；句意是嫌疑人将于周五被提审。

collocations.phrase: be arraigned on charges of murder

collocations.zh: 因玩忽职守而声讨某人

derivatives.zh: arraign 加名词后缀 -ment，义为「提审；传讯程序」
arraign 加 -er，义为「提审者；声讨者」

senses.title: To formally charge in court
senses.definition: to bring an accused person before a court to hear the charges and enter a plea
senses.definitionCN: 把被告带到法庭听取指控并进行答辩
senses.example: The defendant was arraigned on two counts of fraud.
senses.exampleCN: 被告被以两项欺诈罪提审。
senses.why: The Latin prefix ad- plus ratio means to call to account, literally to a reckoning.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁前缀 ad- 加 ratio 意为「传唤对账」，即叫到庭上听清算。

senses.title: To denounce severely
senses.definition: to accuse or criticize someone or something forcefully, often in public
senses.definitionCN: 公开而有力地指责、抨击某人或某事
senses.example: Editorials arraigned the ministry for its slow response.
senses.exampleCN: 社论纷纷声讨该部迟缓的应对。
senses.why: The courtroom image transfers to the court of public opinion.
senses.whyCN: 法庭形象转移到舆论的法庭上。

intro.en: Arraign comes from Old French araisnier, from Latin adrationare, to call to account.
intro.cn: arraign 源自古法语 araisnier，上溯拉丁语 adrationare（传唤对质）。

items.en: Ad plus ratio formed adrationare, to speak to, reason with, call to reckoning.
items.cn: ad 加 ratio 构成 adrationare，义为「对质说理、传唤清算」。

items.en: Araisnier meant to question, address, examine in a legal setting.
items.cn: 古法语 araisnier 意为「质询、当庭讯问」。

items.en: Arraigner passed into legal English with the formal charge sense.
items.cn: 盎格鲁-诺曼语 arraigner 带着正式指控义进入法律英语。

items.en: The spelling arraign was settled, while the verb kept court usage.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 arraign，动词保持法庭用语色彩。

items.en: Today it names the first court appearance in Anglo-American criminal procedure.
items.cn: 现代英语中它指英美刑事程序中的首次出庭受讯。

note.en: Arraign is strictly legal; in metaphor it becomes fierce public blame.
note.cn: arraign 严格属法律用语；比喻时转为激烈的公开谴责。

entries.definitionCN: 提审程序，arraign 的名词形式
安排、整理，词尾发音相近但词义完全不同
十足的、彻头彻尾的（贬义），拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to formally accuse of a crime by grand jury
entries.definitionCN: 由大陪审团正式起诉，与 arraign 同属刑事程序但阶段不同

entries.definition: to bring a criminal case against someone
entries.definitionCN: 对某人提起刑事诉讼，侧重追诉全过程
公开强烈谴责，对应 arraign 的比喻义

normalIntro.en: Connect the word to ratio, a reckoning, to hold its core sense.
normalIntro.cn: 把该词与 ratio（清算）联系起来以把握核心义。

normal.en: ar- (ad-, to) + raign (ratio, reckoning) = called to account.
normal.cn: ar-（ad-，去）+ raign（ratio，清算）＝被传唤对账。

normal.en: The noun is arraignment: the first court hearing.
normal.cn: 名词是 arraignment：首次出庭受讯。

normal.en: Do not confuse with arrange, which only sets things in order.
Standard collocation: arraigned on charges of theft.
normal.cn: 标准搭配：arraigned on charges of theft（因盗窃罪被提审）。

normal.en: Figuratively, critics arraign a policy as a court would.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：批评者如法庭般声讨某项政策。

abstract.en: Picture the accused standing alone under the high courtroom lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象被告独自站在法庭高灯之下。

abstract.en: Hear the clerk reading each charge aloud, one by one.
abstract.cn: 聆听书记员逐条宣读指控。

abstract.en: See a crowd pointing fingers like prosecutors.
abstract.cn: 想象人群如检察官般指指点点。

examples.en: He was arraigned and pleaded not guilty.
examples.cn: 他被提审后表示不认罪。

examples.en: The three suspects will be arraigned tomorrow morning.
examples.cn: 三名嫌疑人将于明早受讯。

examples.en: The essay arraigns modern advertising as a form of deception.
examples.cn: 这篇文章把现代广告声讨为一种欺骗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额·蕊恩」——被告额角冒汗，法官目光如针蕊般盯着他念罪名，这就是「额蕊恩」般的提审场面。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（到）+ ratio（清算、说理）→ adrationare（传唤对质）→ 古法语 araisnier → 英语 arraign；与 reason 同出 ratio 词根。

sensesIntro.en: From calling a defendant to court to calling an offender before the public.
sensesIntro.cn: 由传唤被告到庭延伸到把过错者押上舆论法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the accused called forward to face the charge
core.cn: 核心意象：被告被传唤上前面对指控

intro.en: The prefix ad- (to) fuses with ratio to build this legal verb.
intro.cn: 前缀 ad-（去）与 ratio 融合成这个法律动词。

latinIntro.en: Ratio, reckoning, also gives English reason, ration and rate.
latinIntro.cn: ratio（清算）同时派生出英语的 reason、ration 与 rate。
